description: Ansible repositories: pinned lint tooling in .github/workflows/*.yml.
Use together with the default preset.

customManagers.description: pip pins inside GitHub workflows, e.g. pip install "ansible-core==2.22.0"

packageRules.description: ansible-core, ansible-lint, yamllint and the lint job's Python version must stay compatible, so they move together in one PR, majors included. CI only, never the managed hosts: auto-merged when the lint job passes with the new versions.
